text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The United Nations Secretary General Kofi Annan underlines the need to back the U.N. Mission for a Referendum in Western Sahara.
- Farmers worried that more rains might endanger crops.
- Sugar and Tea National Office to hold board meeting over future prospects after liberalising sugar imports.
- Water bills expected to increase despite heavy rains.
